scope: Prototype only; no commit/push/new P/R/G or formal studies. No original TODO credit.

implementation.canonical_schema_gate: Once per write_file_data: actual main type/name/tbl_name/sql excluding only indexes equals same-SQLite fresh FULL_SCHEMA_SQL cached result; any TEMP schema object, custom schema or autocommit uses retained original per-row entry. Errors are propagated.
implementation.safe_rowid_gate: Before each window: checked usize sum of every literal attempt, checked i64 count conversion and checked max+count less than i64MAX separately for files/literal_index. Unsafe windows retain original mirrors.
implementation.writes: Original base/leaf/identity order preserved; only files_fts/literal_fts move to fixed rowid-bounded INSERT SELECT ORDER BY rowid, after each window.
implementation.atomicity: Same transaction and publication boundary; no changes to epoch/CAS/schema/index/cache/registered parameters.
implementation.error_order: FTS errors may surface after later base/leaf errors within window; exact original first-error ordering is explicitly not claimed.

validation.source: same three production files; complete logical dump and seventh small diagnostic test

actual_sql_observation.literal_select_plan: SEARCH literal_index USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid>? AND rowid<?)

correctness_controls: cross256/513 boundaries; within/across-window OR IGNORE duplicates and late literal attributed to prior file
all logical tables and logical FTS rowid/content/search results; excludes only physical shadow pages and nondeterministic files.indexed_at
nearMAX worstcount causes fallback, including successful legacy random rowid behavior
custom trigger deleting prior literal/base mirror, TEMP trigger/table shadow, foreign-key schema addition all force per-row fallback
late duplicate/FK errors roll back already flushed windows; actual temp rebuild failure retains live generation, logical data and successful reopen

small_diagnostic.scope: 257-file write+commit, schema guard timed; schema creation/fixture/parity/index-recreation/swap not timed. Shared Mac environment; no isolation or100k speedup claim.
